covered:
LENS: boss framework and the Storm, at 2940233 (worktree clean before and after; nothing edited; all probes in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/ : each probe_X.gd is prelude.gd + body_X.gd, built and run by mk.sh).

READ: docs/CLAUDE.md; GDD 1 to 12 (10.3, 5.4, 7.9, 4.6, 5.8, 9.6, 11.1 closely), 13.3, 13.6, 13.7, 14, 15, 18.1; DECISIONS D-028, D-046, D-047, D-048, D-049, D-050; PROGRESS (state, the M6 review's open list, NEEDS OWNER). Code, every line: boss_sim.gd, drive_sim.gd, run_generator.gd, run_state.gd, leg_sim.gd, car_sim.gd, collision.gd, traffic_sim.gd, effect_system.gd, nerves_sim.gd, stop_sim.gd, save.gd, input_log.gd, rng.gd, event_names.gd, wheel_sim.gd, drive_controller.gd; parts: item_sim.gd (wipers, window, haze, leg/telling state, step), hand_sim.gd (step), fault_sim.gd, data_validator.gd (boss and storm schemas), encounter_sim.gd (begin), views gust_view/vehicle_view/sky_view/cabin mirror. Data: legs.json, tuning.json names used, items.json effects and the items probed. Tests: test_boss.gd (T-BOSS-02 and helpers), support/cabin_suite.gd, support/leg_checker.gd, test_run.gd (scripted driver), test_save.gd (T-SAVE-01, T-REPLAY-01).

RAN: T-BOSS-02 (PASS, 1803 checks), T-RUN-01 (PASS). Probes: dust, gusts, stand, blip, walls, walls2, walls3, telling, save, wreck, misc, cramp2, sign2, bossstop, shoulder, salts, names, fuzz.

HELD (no finding): dust thin 8 s / thick 12 s by the road's clock over the whole road (changes at 8, 20, 28, 40, 48, 60, 68 s), unchanged by 47 s of standing, slowed by Focus (first change at 9.408 s real = 7.997 road s). 7 gusts in each of 900 plans, no bends; tell 120 ticks before the push at 40/70/100/130 km/h (141 ticks = 0.9988 road s under Focus); push -1.75 / +2.25 m with the crown (-2.75 / +3.25 Crosswind); gust 1's tell begins on the tick the dust first thickens, nothing breaks. Standing: safe only with the left side on or beyond the road's edge and hazards on (1 mm in the lane is unsafe); hazards switched on up to 119 ticks after the horn save him (by hand 0.20 s); crash from behind: lamps 0 to 2, Nerves +20, gear 3 to 1, tea spilt, position unchanged, immunity 0.8 s; draw 204, 187, 187 hits in 400 waits each, other stream other outcome. Wreck inside the Storm of a Telling: told again 360 ticks later, new seed, nothing of the Storm left (boss, dust, wipe_haze, haze, switches, cramp), its own Storm from the new seed. Cramp exactly once in 8 situations (par, night, Focus, stopped on the point, crawl, pills, Phantom off) and after a restore of the save before the Storm. Haze: 6 sweeps to the cap, window 12.00 s to the cap, nothing clears while open, clear 20 s after shutting. Same plan (byte for byte) in a Telling and by begin_boss for '', crosswind, night_storm. Fork sign after tea names the modifier the Storm then has (9 seeds; tea on the third leg shows Dawn's on Act 3's first fork, as D-046 says), also through the save's text. Saves at the stop before and after the Storm, through Save.to_text/from_text into a new simulation: state equal every 5 s and at the end (tick and time aside, which a save does not keep), events equal. Recorded input logs through the Storm (14,002 ticks, three modifiers, with standing and two draws) replay to the same state hash. Every event name in EventNames.ALL; 36 Storms on seeded random input (1.1 million ticks): no engine error, no broken invariant. Nothing of the Storm's numbers found in code (the only literals: the 0.5 coin of a gust's side, par = gear_speeds[2]; the hit's class 'crash' and the horn's id are code).

KNOWN OR DECIDED, re-measured and NOT counted: under Focus a gust lasts 120 ticks = 0.85 road s and carries 1.4875 m instead of 1.75 (PROGRESS M6 finding 6, D-049: not built at this commit). After a Wreck sim.checkpoint still holds the last stop's save (M6 finding 4, D-049). At the Storm's stop Haze 0.60 becomes 0 and awake/focus/jitters/lit end with no effect_expired (M6 finding 12, D-049). Hazard lights cost nothing and stay on through stops and saves, so the button need never be pressed in the Storm (GDD 4.6 makes them a toggle; only the Storm and the Call read them).

UNVERIFIED / NOT CHECKED: anything drawn or heard (no display): gust streaks in thick dust, the mirror's lights, the sign's text; the tell of the crash from behind uses the sfx id 'horn', the same as his own Snap and a taxi's honk, told apart only by 'behind' (for M10). Reasoned but not reproduced: a second cramp after a collision pushes the car back over the 1,000 m point; a fifth lamp lit on the very tick the Storm's end is crossed (the save point would rebuild 'wrecked' away); a hit from behind swallowed by the 0.8 s immunity of another hit. GDD 6.2 (the news names the next boss modifier) is built nowhere and no decision records it: outside the sections of this lens. Dawn, the Checkpoint and the stand-in bot only as far as they share code. Tuning observations, not findings: at par the first gust's tell starts on the tick of the first thick dust (8.000 s) and gust 4 lies on the cramp's point (1,000 m); a third-gear driver crosses the Storm in 72 s against par 100 s.

findings.title: A tenth of a second off the brake restarts the Storm's 10 s: a dark car can stand in its lane for ever and nothing is ever drawn
findings.where: src/core/boss_sim.gd _step_standing (lines 859-878: any tick with speed > stopped_kmh zeroes _stood, _drawn, _coming); data/legs.json storm.stopped_kmh = 1; pinned by tests/test_boss.gd _check_storm_standing ('standing again is a new wait, from nothing', 'a car that still rolls is not stopped')
findings.gdd: GDD 10.3: "Stopping on the shoulder with hazard lights on is always safe. Stopping without them risks a rear-end crash every 10 s." D-046: "every rear_end_every_s (10 s) of standing, something may come out of the dust behind him ... A car that has moved off or made itself safe within that second is missed."
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_blip.gd (the brake pedal is the only input; middle lane, hazards off, 600 s): brake held all the time: 36 horns, 36 hits, 5 lamps, wrecked. Foot lifted for 11 ticks (0.09 s) every 8.5 s: 0 horns, 0 hits, 0 lamps, top speed 1.10 km/h, the car rolled 1.38 m in the ten minutes. Foot lifted for 15 ticks 0.3 s after each horn: 37 horns, 0 hits. With the Storm's traffic, 120 s: 6 hits and a Wreck against 0. probe_stand.gd: speed held at 1.000 km/h in a lane for 120 s: 6 horns, 6 hits; at 1.0001, 1.5 and 2.0 km/h: 0 and 0. probe_misc.gd (a real Storm, 120 s): right lane, foot lifted 12 ticks every 8.5 s: 0 horns, 0 hits, Nerves 26.9 to 0.0 after 60 s; shoulder with hazards on: Nerves 26.9 to 89.5.
findings.failure: The rule that sends him to the shoulder and makes him spend the hand on the hazard button is void. The foot is free (GDD 4: one hand and one foot), so a player who knows the pulse stops wherever he is for as long as he likes: to wait out thick dust, to smoke and drink with no drift, to calm down at 0.5 Nerves a second. The draw is never made, so there is not even a horn. The lane is safer and kinder than the place the GDD calls safe (see STORM-2).
findings.fix: In _step_standing do not start a new wait on the first tick above stopped_kmh. Keep _stood (and a drawn hit) until the car has really driven off: a number in the Storm's record, e.g. moved_off_kmh = 20 (or a distance from where it stood), with rear_end_tell_s lengthened so that driving off inside the tell is still possible at 12 km/h a second. The existing checks still hold (a car at 3 km/h that never stopped starts no wait; _drive_on at 100 km/h ends one). Append to T-BOSS-02: a pulse of the pedal every 8 s does not keep him unhit.

findings.title: The safe place frays him: a car standing on the shoulder gains 1 Nerves a second, as if it were driving on it; standing in a lane costs nothing
findings.where: src/core/drive_sim.gd _feed_nerves (if car.on_shoulder: nerves.add_rate(_shoulder_rate)); src/core/car_sim.gd _step_edges (on_shoulder is set for a car at rest too); reaches the Storm's safe standing and the Call taken pulled over
findings.gdd: GDD 10.3: "Stopping on the shoulder with hazard lights on is always safe." GDD 10.4: "Pull over, hazards on, then answer | The car is stopped for 30 s: 10 game minutes". GDD 5.1: "a rough shoulder 2.5 m wide (drivable, +1 Nerves per second, speed capped at 70)". D-028: "The rumble strip slows nothing and frays nothing". D-049: "Pulled over, the night waits as at a stop: no timer runs, no call rings, Nerves keep still."
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_shoulder.gd: 30 s on an empty stretch with no road calm: driving on the shoulder at 60 km/h Nerves +30.00; standing on the shoulder +30.00; standing in a lane +0.00. The Call taken 'parked' (shoulder, hazards on): 30.00 s, Clock +10.00 min, Nerves +15.00 (29.5 to 44.5). probe_stand.gd: Storm, shoulder, hazards on, 300 s: 0 horns, 0 hits, Nerves reach 100.0, 8 Snaps (the first after 70 s, then one every 30 s). probe_misc.gd: real Storm with its traffic, 120 s on the shoulder with hazards: Nerves 26.9, then 39.5 at 20 s, 59.5 at 60 s, 89.5 at 120 s; in the lane with the pulse of STORM-1: 0.0 after 60 s.
findings.failure: The one place GDD 10.3 calls safe is the one place in the Storm where standing wears him out: a minute's halt brings Tremor and Tunnel, two minutes Pound, 70 s on a quiet road the first Snap. Pulling over for the Call costs 15 Nerves on top of the 10 minutes the GDD names as its price. The shoulder is rough to drive on; a car at rest is shaken by nothing, and with the officer (D-049) the same shoulder already leaves his Nerves still.
findings.fix: Add the shoulder's rate only while the car moves: in _feed_nerves, `if car.on_shoulder and car.speed > 0.0` (or above the set piece's stopped_kmh). Record it beside D-028. Append a check to T-BOSS-02 (safe standing leaves Nerves to the road's own rates) and to T-CALL-01 (the Call taken pulled over costs the 10 minutes and nothing else).

findings.title: Tail lights close the road three abreast once he has driven slower than par: D-046's 'always a way past' holds only for a car that never leaves third gear's speed
findings.where: src/core/boss_sim.gd _plan_storm (each tail light is put spawn_ahead in front of wherever he is when he passes its trigger, at 60 to 70 km/h); src/core/leg_sim.gd _spawn; tests/test_boss.gd _check_storm_tail_lights reads the plan's list only, nothing drives it
findings.gdd: D-046: "Tail lights. One vehicle at a time, 140 to 220 m apart, at 60 to 70 km/h, never two in a row in one lane: there is always something to follow and always a way past." GDD 10.3: "In thick dust the player follows tail lights." GDD 12.4 rule 8: "The generator never builds a wall."
findings.evidence: Real LegSim and TrafficSim with a ghost car that touches nothing, and a search over every place across the lanes he could have reached (4 m/s sideways). /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_walls.gd: at par a way past in all 200 seeds, yet two in a row in one lane on the road in 26 of 200 seeds (least gap 28.9 m); at 70 km/h a vehicle in every lane within two car lengths of one another in 173 of 200 seeds, 21.9% of the drive. probe_walls3.gd (the car's own 12 km/h a second): 65 km/h wanted in thick dust and par in thin: no way through without touching in 3 of 300 seeds (93 at 1952 m, 99 at 1968 m, 174 at 1869 m); second gear for the first 600 m, then third: 23 of 300 (walls between 1330 and 1620 m); first gear 150 m, second to 400 m, then third (a driver who stopped at the stall before the Storm): 13 of 300. The three follower drives repeated in DriveSim, moving into each lane 2 s before the wall: a hit in every lane (seed 93: lane 0 at 88.02 s, lane 1 at 87.58 s, lane 2 at 85.90 s; seeds 99 and 174 the same). probe_walls2.gd shows what a wall is, e.g. seed 25: car lane 0 at -1.3 m 67 km/h, taxi lane 1 at +2.4 m 64 km/h, taxi lane 2 at +4.5 m 64 km/h.
findings.failure: When he drives near the tail lights' own speed they are laid side by side and stay there (speeds differ by a few km/h, some by nothing). Back at par he meets a rolling wall across all three lanes and can only sit behind it at 60-odd km/h, on the Clock, until it drifts apart or the Storm ends; the shoulder is capped at 70. The player who does what GDD 10.3 tells him, follow tail lights in thick dust, or who enters slowly after a stop, is the one who meets it; the par driver of the tests never does.
findings.fix: In LegSim._spawn hold a Storm's tail light back (the waiting list is there) while putting it on the road would leave no lane free within a data-set distance of it, e.g. storm.tail_lights.free_lane_m; or lay the tail lights by road position instead of by his progress. Append to T-BOSS-02 a drive at 65 km/h and one that changes pace, asserting a free lane beside every vehicle he comes level with.

findings.title: The Wide mirror and the cracked mirror do nothing to the Storm's one mirror tell
findings.where: src/core/boss_sim.gd _step_standing / the snapshot's rear_end_in; mirror_lead_s and mirror_tell_delay_s reach only encounter.tell_shift (src/core/drive_sim.gd _step_encounter)
findings.gdd: GDD 7.6: "Wide mirror | Mirror tells arrive 5 s earlier". GDD 6.3: "Cracked mirror | Mirror tells arrive 2 s later". D-050: "The mirror has a glass. In it: the two lights of what comes up behind him in the dust, nearer and wider apart through the second of tell (GDD 10.3)".
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_misc.gd, standing dark in a lane, road stream 11: no item: lights in the mirror from 9.000 s, horn at 9.000 s, hit at 10.000 s. With wide_mirror fitted (snapshot mirror_shift 5.0): 9.000, 9.000, 10.000. With the cracked_mirror fault (mirror_shift -2.0, mirror_delay 2.0): 9.000, 9.000, 10.000.
findings.failure: A bay and 35 cash spent on the Wide mirror buy nothing in the one boss that has a tell in the mirror, and a cracked mirror costs nothing there. Two rows of the GDD that are true on Patrol and Tailgater legs are silently false in the Storm.
findings.fix: Either move the lights by the same shift (make the draw rear_end_tell_s + mirror_lead_s before the hit and show the lights that long; with a cracked mirror the lights come 2 s late, which leaves the horn), or record in DECISIONS that what comes out of the dust is announced by its horn and the mirror's items do not move it.

findings.title: Night storm changes nothing he can measure with two headlights, and nobody is asked: it is decided in D-046 but not on the NEEDS OWNER list
findings.where: src/core/drive_sim.gd visibility(); src/core/boss_sim.gd _plan_storm (condition night); data/legs.json boss_modifiers night_storm; src/view/sky_view.gd (the fog's colour is the only difference drawn); D-046 'Night storm'
findings.gdd: GDD 10.3: "Modifiers: Crosswind (gusts 50% stronger); Night storm (only the headlight cone)." GDD 9.6: "the next fork sign also shows the next boss modifier". GDD 1.4 rule 7: "Mark anything a human must judge as NEEDS OWNER in PROGRESS.md." D-046: "with both headlights the dust is always nearer".
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_misc.gd, thin / thick dust in metres, plain against night: nothing 40.0/15.0 and 40.0/15.0; high beam the same; fog lamps 56.0/21.0 and 56.0/21.0; it differs only with a dead headlight on low beam (night 30.0/15.0; 42.0/21.0 with fog lamps) and with both dark glasses together (39.0). Two Storms of one seed side by side for 8,655 ticks: the only snapshot keys that ever differ are 'night' and 'boss_modifier'. probe_save.gd T6: the same inputs give the same run to the digit with '' and with night_storm (14,002 ticks, Nerves 47.219).
findings.failure: A quarter of Act 2's Tellings draw Night storm (boss_modifier_chance 0.5, two modifiers). The tea stall's sign names it for 20 game minutes and the Storm he then drives is the plain one in a darker colour; the headlight knob has no use in it. It agrees with D-046, so it is a question for the owner, and PROGRESS does not list it.
findings.fix: Give the modifier's record a number that bites, e.g. "cone_share": the cone a Night storm leaves him, under thin_m on low beam and over it on high beam, so that the knob's cross-reach buys sight; or enter it under NEEDS OWNER.

findings.title: The drive controller waits for an event called "wrecked"; the simulation announces "wreck"
findings.where: src/game/drive_controller.gd line 140 (added in 2940233): `elif type == "boss_ended" or type == "pulled_over" or type == "call_resolved" or type == "wrecked":`
findings.gdd: GDD 13.6: "... `call_started`, `call_resolved`, `wreck`, `arrived`, `line_requested`, `sfx_requested`." D-049: "After a Wreck there is no saved Telling to continue."
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_names.gd printed: res://src/game/drive_controller.gd:140 compares an event's type with "wrecked", which is not in EventNames.ALL (has "wreck": true). The same probe wrecked a car in the Storm; the simulation announced boss_started, hit, lamp_lit, nerves_threshold_crossed, wreck.
findings.failure: The branch never runs: a Wreck in a set piece leaves no line on the console, and whatever is hung on that branch later (D-049's rule that a Wreck leaves no save is still to be built) will wait for a name that never comes.
findings.fix: "wrecked" becomes "wreck"; let a smoke run or a test compare every name the game's listeners use with EventNames.ALL.

findings.title: The seed of a Telling told again is the seed of a boss of the Telling before it: BOSS_SALT and RETELLING_SALT are both 3000
findings.where: src/core/run_generator.gd BOSS_SALT = 3000 (boss_seed: salt 3000 + act); src/core/run_state.gd RETELLING_SALT = 3000 (retell: salt 3000 + retellings)
findings.gdd: GDD 13.3: "Use four seeded `RandomNumberGenerator` streams derived from the Telling seed". run_generator.gd's own words: "Salts that keep the fork draws and the leg seeds apart from other uses of the Telling seed."
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-storm/probe_salts.gd: Telling seed 4242: retelling 1 has seed 3202647627885783600 == boss_seed(4242, act 1): true; retelling 2 == boss_seed(previous seed, act 2): true; retelling 3 == act 3: true (the same for seeds 1 and 987654321). First number of the retold Telling's road stream 3318735439 == first number of the generator that drew the Checkpoint's modifier: true; first number of its shop stream 1313411876 == first number of the generator of the Checkpoint's plan: true.
findings.failure: Nothing a player can see today. But after a Wreck the new Telling's road stream (fault deck, the Storm's draws, calls) and its shop stream are the very generators that drew the last Telling's boss modifier and laid out its boss: seeds the code means to keep apart are one, and whatever later counts on them being apart (the bot's statistics, a daily seed) inherits the tie.
findings.fix: RETELLING_SALT = 4000 (clear of 1000 to 3003); a line in T-GEN-02 or T-RUN-02 that the ranges of the salts do not meet.
